description.narrative: In 2020 and 2021, Tamweelcom’s lending activity was limited to well-performing clients. In addition, portfolio quality deteriorated due to a less favorable risk environment under Covid-19 lockdown measures. FMO’s USD 10mln Risk Sharing Facility and Capacity Development support should enable Tamweelcom to continue supporting its clients and reach additional micro/small business in line with its social mission. In addition to being underserved by local banks, this segment's income stream is highly vulnerable to Covid-19 restrictions.
